_meta.source: POI data imported from VulnonaMAP (https://vulnona.com/game/map/) — created by Coco.N.  Coordinates converted from Vulnona Simple Code to Unreal cm via ×1000.  Wallows are manually curated (not present in VulnonaMAP's schema).
taxonomy_changelog: v4 (2026-04-17): food & items imported from data_4.txt — per-species granular keys (food_boar, food_deer, food_fish, food_gastro, etc. — see FOOD_SPECIES_TO_KEY for full list) with ``species`` field on each entry and optional ``radii`` for Vulnona's food-area mode.  Grouped aliases (food_terrestrial_prey, food_aquatic, food_fruits, food_nuts, food_vegetables, food_flowers, food_other_plants, food_mushrooms, food_earthworks) and a foods_all union emitted so the legend/layer panel can toggle at any granularity.

v3 (2026-04-16): full Vulnona taxonomy — split landmarks into surface/underwater/mountains, water into river_pond/waterfall, caves into surface/underwater plus cave_exits_up/down, added air_currents/updrafts and roads/trails/ditches/hoists.  Legacy aggregate keys (landmarks, water, caves) emitted for backwards compat.
v2 (2026-04-16): initial Vulnona import — sanctuaries, salt_licks, migrations, patrol_zones, landmarks, water, caves, areas, plus manual wallows.
v5 (2026-04-17): merged 160 meat entries from data_2.txt (3 months fresher than data_4); added food_galli category (Gallimimus AI prey); cross-verified via wiredredman Steam guide.

This is a POND fed by Hollow Falls. Recommend either (a) renaming to 'Hollow Falls Pond' will not help — same regex hit; (b) reorder classifier to put pond/lake checks before waterfall when name contains both; OR (c) hardcode-override this entry to subtype:pond.
